main_issue: How to share the single window corner of the living room among A's permanent desk, C's laundry rack, B's weekend seating, and D's prayer space.

A-B.evidence: B pushes folding desk/weekend packing (12, 15, 21, 23); A refuses: 'I can't tear it down and rebuild it every week' (16, 22).

A-C.evidence: C backs B: 'If your desk is permanent, where does my laundry rack go?' (24); A replies the rack needn't move (25), but C says it's too tight (26).

A-D.evidence: D notes a permanent desk leaves no space for prayer mat (19); A keeps desk fixed (20); D proposes clearing the corner (27), which A hasn't accepted.

B-C.evidence: C: 'He's right' (24) agreeing with B that the desk can't be permanent in a shared space.

B-D.evidence: D echoes B's objection to permanent desk (19); D proposes clearing the corner (27), compatible with B; but B's weekend claim conflicts with D's daily prayer need (5-6).

C-D.evidence: C asks 'Where would Agent D's things go?' (26); D thanks C: 'That's the problem' (27).
